locations.title: Thustodyne M23 Wonder Weapon Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- You'll need to gather three items around the map to build the Thrustodyne M23:
   - [Water Pressure Gauge](#loc=942682)
      - First, head to Washington Ave. and grab the [Water Valve](#loc=942681). 
      - Then, head to Fuller's Liberty Lanes and place it into the [Pressure Gauge](#loc=942675) on the wall.
      - Hold interact on it until the bar fills up fully while defending against zombies.
      - Once full, the Water Pressure Gauge will pop out onto the floor.
   - [Electrical Wires](#loc=942685)
      - Acquire a Mangler Cannon and use it to blast open the doors to Radio House.
      - Interact with the trash piles until you come across the one containing the Electrical Wires.
   - [Handbrake](#loc=942683)
      - Head to the Cemetery and kill zombies until the Groundskeeper spawns.
      - Kill the Groundskeeper and pick up the [Toolshed Key](#loc=942679).
      - Head to the Groundskeeper's Yard and open the shed to acquire the Handbrake.
- Once all three are collected, head to the [Workbench](#loc=942202) in the Motor Lodge to build the Thrustodyne M23.

locations.title: L.T.G. Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- To build the L.T.G., you must first complete the [Thustodyne M23 Wonder Weapon Easter Egg](#loc=942669) and interact with the [Generator](#loc=942684) in the Dark Aether.
- Then, use the wonder weapon to pull in three different parts around the map:
   - [L.T.G. Part](#loc=942689)
   - [L.T.G. Part](#loc=942699)
   - [L.T.G. Part](#loc=942687)
- After all parts are collected, you can build the L.T.G. at the [Workbench](#loc=942253) on top of the Savings & Loan building.

locations.title: Liberty Falls Main Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, complete both the [Thustodyne M23 Wonder Weapon Easter Egg](#loc=942669) and the [L.T.G. Easter Egg](#loc=942670).
- Head back to the [Generator](#loc=942684) and pick up the [Aether Canister](#loc=942711).
- Bring it to the [Dark Aether Field Generator](#loc=942244) and place it on one of the trap's generators.
- Head to the Cemetery and place the L.T.G. under the [Aether Cloud](#loc=942728) and defend it until an HVT spawns.
- Bring the HVT to the Dark Aether Field Generator and kill it inside the trap next to the canister.
- Bring the canister back to the Generator and place it inside, then grab the [Strauss Counter](#loc=942712).
- Head to the three projectors around the map and set them to a color depending on what the Strauss Counter has for the value (Green value = Red projector, Red value = Green projector, Yellow value = Yellow projector):
   - [Projector](#loc=942716)
   - [Projector](#loc=942714)
   - [Projector](#loc=942713)
- After all are set, head to East Main Street and grab the [Aether Canister](#loc=942717) there.
- Head to the [Dark Aether Field Generator](#loc=942193) and place it next to one of their generators.
- Take the L.T.G. and place it under the [Aether Cloud](#loc=942715) again, then defend it.
- Bring the HVT and kill it in the trap next to the canister.
- Finally, place it back into the generator to start the final boss fight.

locations.title: Pool Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Head to the [Pool Table](#loc=942722) in Fuller's Liberty Lanes and shoot the Pool Balls to get a free 100 essence.

locations.title: Vending Machine Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Once per round, you can crouch and melee the [Vending Machine](#loc=942725) next to the Motor Lodge to get free loot.
   - If you melee it with Melee Macchiato, the vending machine will permanently break.

locations.title: Destroy Something Beautiful Song Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Around the map, there are three headphones that need to be interacted with:
   - [Headphones](#loc=942721)
   - [Headphones](#loc=942729)
   - [Headphones](#loc=942731)

locations.title: Mr. Peeks Car Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Around the map are three cars which can contain Mr. Peeks in the back seat:
   - [Mr. Peeks Car](#loc=942733)
   - [Mr. Peeks Car](#loc=942730)
   - [Mr. Peeks Car](#loc=942732)
- If shot with a mangler cannon to destroy the car, loot will pop out.
   - Mr. Peeks will show up in another car if his is destroyed five rounds later.

locations.title: Bank Vault Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Around the map, there are three Sticky Notes that have codes on them:
   - Savings & Loan: [Sticky Note](#loc=942736)
   - Olly's Comics: [Sticky Note](#loc=942735)
   - Fuller's Liberty Lanes: [Sticky Note](#loc=942723)
- Input these in that specific order into the vault to open the vault.
   - The vault contains lockboxes that can be opened every round with the keys that drop after killing HVTs.
   - You can only enter the vault once per round.

locations.title: Aetherella Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- After completing the [Thustodyne M23 Wonder Weapon Easter Egg](#loc=942669), use the wonder weapon to collect 9 Aetherella figurines around the map:
   - [Aetherella Figurine](#loc=942749)
   - [Aetherella Figurine](#loc=942748)
   - [Aetherella Figurine](#loc=942746)
   - [Aetherella Figurine](#loc=942747)
   - [Aetherella Figurine](#loc=942753)
   - [Aetherella Figurine](#loc=942754)
   - [Aetherella Figurine](#loc=942750)
   - [Aetherella Figurine](#loc=942752)
   - [Aetherella Figurine](#loc=942751)
- Once all are collected, you will turn into Aetherella for a limited time.
   - While Aetherella, you can interact with the [Aetherella Trap](#loc=942297) to get a speed boost.

locations.title: Shooting Cans Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Outside the Cemetery window, there is a line of [Cans](#loc=942756).
- Without missing and in under 20 seconds, shoot every can to receive a free Deadshot Daquiri perk.

locations.title: Raining Zombies Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- On top of the church is a [Mangler Head](#loc=942758).
- Shoot the Mangler Head with any sort of an explosion to make it explode.
- Zombies will come raining from the sky, each dropping a variety of loot.

locations.title: Bowling Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Around the map, there are five sets of shoes that must be shot:
   - [Shoes](#loc=942738)
   - [Shoes](#loc=942739)
   - [Shoes](#loc=942741)
   - [Shoes](#loc=942742)
   - [Shoes](#loc=942740)
- After all five are shot, you'll be transported into Fuller's Liberty Lanes for a bowling minigame.
   - Every five rounds after completing the easter egg, another set of [Shoes](#loc=942762) will spawn that, when shot, will instantly start the minigame.

locations.title: Unrest in Peace Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, get a Chopper Gunner Kill Streak and, while using it, destroy the [Barrel](#loc=942760) next to Washington Ave. Rooftops.
- Pick up the [Shovel](#loc=942761) on the ground nearby.
- Head to the Cemetery and you can use it to dig up the graves there, giving a variety of loot.

locations.title: Dancing Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- With two people, head to each of the Viewfinders overlooking the mountain:
   - [Viewfinder](#loc=942743)
   - [Viewfinder](#loc=942744)
- Aim both viewfinders at the dancing zombie on the cliff and watch it until lights appear behind it.
- Every zombie on the map will teleport into the bus behind the viewfinders and start to dance.

locations.title: Blood Pool Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- On a Vermin round, head to the [Pool](#loc=942768) and quickly throw three semtex inside.
- An orb will spawn and drop a variety of loot.

locations.title: Fire Bomb Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Inside the Dark Aether Church are two sets of candles:
   - [Candles](#loc=945711)
   - [Candles](#loc=945712)
- When both are shot with a gun upgraded with the Napalm Burst upgrade, they will light and blue fire molotovs will drop and light up the ground inside the church, once a game.
